messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: prediction from colext object
parts:
Dear all,

 

I have fitted a dynamic occupancy model to crossbill survey data from a sample of 267 quadrats in Switzerland and now I want to predict one of the parameters for all 41k quadrats in Switzerland. The detection part of the model is this (year is a factor with 9 levels and the other are continuous covariates):

pformula = ~year + elev + I(elev^2) + forest + I(forest^2) + elev:forest + elev:I(forest^2) + I(elev^2):forest + I(elev^2):I(forest^2) + date + I(date^2)

 

What I did to get predictions is this:

nd <- data.frame(year="2003", elev = EP, forest = FP, date = 0)
E.DET <- predict(fm27, type="det", newdata = nd)

 

unmarked then tells me this:
Error in `contrasts<-`(`*tmp*`, value = contr.funs[1 + isOF[nn]]) :
  contrasts can be applied only to factors with 2 or more levels

What have I done wrong ? Thanks for your help.

 

Kind regards  --  Marc

messages.author: 527e14923215b7e4
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] prediction from colext object
parts:
Hi Marc,

This is a known bug that I have not had time to fix. One solution is to make sure that the factor in the newdata object has the same levels as the original factor used to fit the model. Something like this should work:

nd <- data.frame(year=factor("2003", levels=as.character(2003:2010)), elev = EP, forest = FP, date = 0)
E.DET <- predict(fm27, type="det", newdata = nd)

Cheers,
Richard

messages.subject: RE: [unmarked] prediction from colext object
parts:
hi Richard,
 
thanks a lot; this works. Had to divide up my total prediction data frame into 4 smaller chunks in order for R to be able to handle the vectors involved.
 
Kind regards  --  Marc
